user.title: Connect to letv_daemon
user.description: Enter the address of the always-on host running letv_daemon. Home Assistant talks to its Web API and never calls ADB directly.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate letv_daemon
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current access token for {host}:{port}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach letv_daemon. Check the host, port and service status.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This letv_daemon instance is already configured.

init.title: letv_daemon options
init.description: State polling interval in seconds. The daemon refreshes its own cache roughly every 5 seconds.
